concerns.text: Tasks T046 and T047 implement 'Topological Contextualization' and 'Topological Interpretation' (calculating LZC/PE ratios to classify 'Adaptive Simplification' vs 'Degenerative Noise'). This directly violates FR-003 which mandates 'only Lempel-Ziv and Permutation Entropy' and the Plan's explicit rejection of 'unauthorized scope creep' (TDA/topological metrics). The task list contradicts the spec's constraint by adding a forbidden interpretive layer.

T002b (Data Validation Gate) is marked incomplete, yet FR-001 and SC-001 mandate a hard halt if N < 30 or variables are missing. The task description correctly identifies the logic, but its incomplete status means the spec's mandatory 'halt with error' constraint is not preserved in the implementation plan.

T012a (Epoch Rejection >±100µV) and T012b (Segment Length <120s) are marked incomplete. FR-002 explicitly mandates rejecting epochs >±100µV and segments <120s. The incomplete status of these tasks means the spec's mandatory preprocessing constraints are not preserved.

T016 (Permutation Entropy) is marked incomplete. FR-003 mandates calculating 'Lempel-Ziv complexity AND permutation entropy'. The incomplete status of T016 means the spec's mandatory feature extraction constraint is not preserved.

T021 (Benjamini-Hochberg Correction) is marked incomplete. FR-005 mandates applying BH correction for multiple comparisons. The incomplete status of T021 means the spec's mandatory statistical correction constraint is not preserved.

T037 (Collinearity Diagnostics/VIF) is marked incomplete. SC-004 mandates VIF < 5 as a success criterion. The incomplete status of T037 means the spec's mandatory collinearity constraint is not preserved.

T027 (Memory ≤ 7GB) and T036 (Runtime ≤ 6h) are marked incomplete. SC-002 and SC-003 mandate these performance constraints. The incomplete status of these tasks means the spec's mandatory deployment constraints are not preserved.
